rows.note: Use this for a show or program put on for people to watch or enjoy.

example.english: Tonight's entertainment programme is quite good.
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 go3 zit3 muk6 gei2 hou2 tai2

rows.note: Use this for the performance itself, especially when performers are presenting something to an audience rather than referring to the whole program.

example.english: Their performance was great entertainment for the whole audience.
example.traditional: 佢哋嘅表演令全場觀眾都笑晒。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 ge3 biu2 jin2 ling6 cyun4 coeng4 gun1 zung3 dou1 siu3 saai3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for entertainment as an enjoyable leisure activity or diversion.

example.english: After work, I usually watch movies for entertainment.
example.traditional: 放工之後，我通常睇戲當娛樂。
example.jyutping: fong3 gung1 zi1 hau6 ngo5 tung1 soeng4 tai2 hei3 dong3 jyu4 lok6
